Could someone explain the reason this flag limit broke up, then the origin failed? I traced the origin back to see if there was anything that was likely to be faked out to, but I don't see anything. Anyone got any ideas?

Maybe that area is also called DP, but I don't know; the fact is in that area was important and searched liquidity to return back after breakout. We also have to look the whole move of the price
